name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – After § 35 – Am 27
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 35a. Stresses that it is extremely serious that the European Union is unable to demonstrate simplicity and efficiency, and that this way of operating puts us at a disadvantage compared to our competitors in a globalised economy, which are far more reactive and pragmatic;
